At AHA, we provide a better way. Your way.   

We’ve spent years developing opportunities that take GPs to new levels in business and life.  Sure, the money is amazing, but it is so much more than that. 

 At AHA, you’re respected and championed on your journey of growth as a practitioner and person. 

•	Medicare receipts $450,000+ per year 

•	With 30,000 active patients, an instant, full list of appointments is guaranteed 

•	DPA location, mixed billing 

•	Specialised practice opportunities 

•	Modern practice with state of the art training facilities 

•	Enjoy the beach lifestyle just 30 minutes from Adelaide CBD 

•	Family friendly suburb with excellent schools 

•	Multiple, flexible opportunities are available now 

•	So much more! 

A bit more about us.   

Over four decades, Australia Health Alliance (AHA) has helped doctors reach their business and lifestyle goals, while earning a reputation for delivering life changing care for our South Australian community. With more than 30,000 patients across two clinics in the fast growing, metropolitan suburb of Seaford, doctors at AHA make a genuine impact supporting people with a diverse range of health needs. 

Be part of a new diabetes service  and work collaboratively with our team to provide improved health outcomes to our community.  We are also growing our  pain management support services  and are keen to support a GP in building their business in this field. 

AHA provides purpose-built, state of the art facilities with fully equipped consulting rooms, extended hours and pathology collection centre.    

Next steps.   

Interested?  

Reach out to our team now for a confidential initial discussion. 

Contact Jessica, Practice Manager, on 0402 636 031 or via email jmcivor@seafordmedical.com.au 

Or does it sound too good to be true? 

 We’ll arrange a chat with one of our GPs, so you can hear firsthand about their experience with AHA.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Associate Nurse Unit Manager | Acute-Mood





Job no: 946370

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide Metro Southern

Categories: Mental Health, Nursing-Midwifery, Public Health




 

Southern Adelaide Local Health Network - Oaklands Park- Acute-Mood Team 

Salary $107,487 - $114,917 p.a. (Pro Rata) RN-M2A| Full Time, Ongoing Position 

Lead the Way in Acute Mental Health Nursing | Associate Nurse Unit Manager

Flinders Medical Centre's Acute-Mood team is looking for an experienced and dynamic registered nurse ready to move into a leadership role that makes a real difference to community mental health care across Adelaide's southern metro region. As Associate Nurse Unit Manager, you'll guide and support a dedicated nursing team while championing recovery-oriented, person-centred care for consumers at some of their most vulnerable moments.

About the role: 

Reporting to the Team Manager, this role is responsible for the delivery of a range of clinical activities, including mental health and psychosocial assessments, risk assessments, treatment and care planning, therapeutic interventions, advocacy and liaison with other community service providers.

Duties for the role will include:

Providing proficient, person centred, clinical nursing care and-or individual case management to patients-clients in a defined clinical area,

Monitoring patient-client care plans to ensure appropriate care outcomes are achieved on a daily basis,

Assisting and supporting the Team Manager or equivalent in management, clinical, and education activities,

Planning and coordinating services within the multi-disciplinary team,

Acting to resolve local and-or immediate clinical care or service delivery problems

About you:

 Registered as a Nurse by the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia and who holds a current practicing certificate. Must be enrolled in an approved mental health course or hold a qualification in mental health practice,

Effective communication, problem solving, conflict resolution and negotiation skills,

Registered Nurse-Midwife with at least 3 years, full time equivalent, post registration experience,

Demonstrated competence in mental health nursing practice in accordance with the relevant standards,

Experience in the leadership and direction of student nurses, enrolled nurses and less experienced registered nurses

Please see the attached Role Description for additional information.

Want To Know More? Contact: Louise Hann, Team Manager - SCMHS Marion - Acute-Mood Team, (08) 7425 8500, Louise.Hann@sa.gov.au

We offer a broad range of products and services including newspapers, magazines, stationery, greeting cards, gifts, lottery products, tobacco products, and convenience items. Due to continued business growth, we are seeking an experienced and motivated Retail Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our store.     Position Overview   The Retail Manager will be responsible for the overall management and performance of the business, ensuring efficient operations, high customer service standards, effective staff supervision, and achievement of sales and profitability objectives.     Key Responsibilities   • Determine and manage the product mix to meet customer demand and maximise sales opportunities;  • Monitor stock levels, coordinate purchasing activities, and maintain effective inventory control systems;  • Formulate and implement purchasing, merchandising, and marketing strategies to promote the business and increase revenue;  • Develop and maintain customer service standards to ensure a positive shopping experience;  • Promote and advertise the business's products and services through in-store promotions and local marketing initiatives;  • Assist customers with product enquiries and provide advice on product selection and use;  • Maintain accurate records of stock movements, sales performance, and financial transactions;  • Prepare and monitor budgets, analyse sales trends, and implement strategies to improve business performance;  • Recruit, train, supervise, and manage staff, including preparation of rosters and performance management;  • Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, company policies, and relevant legislation;  • Liaise with suppliers and negotiate purchasing arrangements to ensure product availability and cost efficiency;  • Monitor store presentation and ensure merchandising standards are maintained at all times.     Skills and Experience Required   To be successful in this role, applicants must possess:  • A relevant qualification in Business, Management, Retail Operations, or a related field; and/or  • At least one year of relevant retail management experience;  • Demonstrated experience in staff supervision, inventory management, budgeting, and retail operations;  • Strong leadership, communication, and customer service skills;  • Ability to analyse business performance and implement operational improvements;  • Sound knowledge of workplace health and safety requirements and retail compliance obligations. result.description:
Margaret River, Full Time, Hospitality
Vacancy Listing Dates 24/07/2026 to 21/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17458
- Hotel Manager, Hotel Service Manager, Landscape Gardener, and Handyperson roles
- Full time positions available
- Opportunities with the Grande Escape Resort in Margaret River

The Grande Escape Resort in Margaret River have the following vacancies on offer:
- Hotel Manager
- Hotel Service Manager
- Landscape Gardener
- Handyperson

Hotel Manager

The manager will assume responsibility for overseeing day-to-day operations, ensuring guest satisfaction, directing staff, and maintaining profitability. The multifaceted responsibilities of this position demand business acumen, exceptional interpersonal skills, exceptional problem-solving skills and a genuine passion for guest service.

We are seeking a Hotel Manager to:
- Manage hotel services - accommodation and food and beverage.
- Oversee events and conferences.
- Manage corporate bookings and enquiries.
- Human resource management.
- Troubleshoot any issues arising in hotel operations.
- Liaise with contractors and suppliers.
- Supervise any maintenance work and renovations.
- Safeguard security and compliance, conducting inspections where necessary.
- Manage heads of departments or entire teams including supervision of ordering stock
- Drive forward sales strategies and oversee expenditure
- Handle financial responsibilities by ensuring high occupancy levels,
- Manage budgets and controlling expenditures.
- Track hotel revenues, setting sales targets and optimise profits.
- Analyse sales figures, reports and the different market segments and channels to define the best-suited pricing and distribution strategies.
- Maintain statistical and financial records.
- Monitor and motivate staff with constructive communication in a positive work environment and a shared vision of targets and career progression.

Skills and Qualifications:
- Diploma or degree in hospitality management or a related field.
- Two to five years of experience in a supervisory or management capacity within the hospitality industry.
- Exceptional leadership, interpersonal, and organisational abilities.
- Ability to lead people not just manage them.
- Proficiency in computer applications and hospitality management systems (RMS is preferable or similar).
- Willingness to work variable shifts, including weekends and holidays.
- Possess a police check or the ability to complete the check.

Hotel Service Manager

We are seeking a Hotel Service Manager to supervise daily operations and coordinate hotel service workers to ensure exceptional guest experiences. This will involve managing teams across front office, housekeeping, and concierge, balancing staff rosters, resolving grievances, and maintaining rigorous safety standards.

Key Responsibilities:
- Directs and delegates duties to housekeepers, maintenance and reception staff.
- Maintains attendance records, manages shift rosters, resolves staff grievances, and enforces safety regulations.
- Perform front office reception duties and ensure all hotel amenities meet strict brand and hygiene standards.
- Oversees the efficiency of hotel units and suggests operational improvements.

Qualifications & Requirements:
- Requires an AQF Certificate III/IV or Diploma in hospitality management.
- Requires two to three years of relevant on-the-job training or industry experience.
- Specialisation as a Front Office Manager with housekeeping experience; Food and beverage an advantage

Landscape Gardener

We are also seeking a Landscape Gardener to join our team, applicants must have at least 2-3 years' experience in a similar role.

Duties include:
- Preparing and maintaining seedbeds and growing sites
- Propagating and planting trees, bushes, hedges, flowers and bulbs
- Preparing lawn areas by spreading top soil and planting grass, and by laying instant turf
- Maintaining planted and grassed areas by weeding, trimming, fertilising, watering and mowing
- Ensuring the grounds are clean for guests
- Pruning trees and hedges, and installing plant support and protection devices
- Preparing plans and drawings, selecting materials and plants, and scheduling landscape construction
- Setting out and installing hardscape and softscape structures
- Constructing gravel and paved areas, walls, fences, pergolas, ponds, barbecues and garden furniture
- Examining trees to assess their condition and determine treatment
- Lopping limbs off trees and shaping branches using chain and handsaws
- Spraying and dusting plants and trees to control insects and disease, and felling diseased trees

Handyperson

In addition, we require a Handyperson to join our team full time as well.

You will be responsible for:
- General repairs around the property and rooms.
- Plumbing repairs including Unblocking sinks, fixing leaky taps, and replacing tap washers.
- Simple electrical repairs
- Painting and carpentry repairs to ensure the rooms and grounds are in good condition
- Outdoor maintenance such as clearing gutters, fixing fences, mowing lawns, and general yard upkeep.

Applicants must have:
- At least 1 year of experience in a similar role
- Proficiency in using hand and power tools.
- Basic working knowledge of carpentry, plumbing, and electrical systems
- Ability to perform manual labour, including lifting heavy objects and standing for long periods.
- Strong communication skills
- A valid driver's licence and relevant construction induction training (e.g., White Card in Australia)

A salary between $70,000 - $100,000 will be offered to the successful candidates.

If you are ready to take your career to the next level in a challenging, busy yet rewarding position, this may be the perfect opportunity for you.

Apply now! -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17458.php

Sponsorship may be available to the right person.

result.description:
Our client, Durgamaa Pty Ltd, trading as Jay Bhavani Indian Vegetarian Restaurant, is seeking an experienced full-time Chef to join its kitchen team in Williams Landing, Victoria. The position offers an annual salary range of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience.

Jay Bhavani operates as a full-service  Indian vegetarian restaurant offering a wide range of traditional Indian dishes, from flavourful street food favourites to hearty meals that will satisfy taste buds. The business is committed to delivering the best vegetarian experience, making every meal a celebration of taste, tradition, and quality.

Key responsibilities include:

•	Planning menus featuring Indian cuisine, calculating food and labour costs, and arranging the purchase of food supplies, spices and ingredients.
•	Checking the quality of Indian dishes throughout preparation, cooking and presentation.
•	Discussing food preparation matters relating to the restaurant's menu with managers, dietitians, kitchen staff and service staff.
•	Demonstrating cooking techniques and providing guidance on the preparation of Indian dishes and food preparation procedures.
•	Preparing and cooking a variety of Indian dishes according to menu standards.
•	Explaining and maintaining hygiene, food safety and cleanliness requirements throughout kitchen operations.
•	Assisting with the selection, training and supervision of kitchen staff when required.
•	Freezing, storing and preserving food items, including spices, sauces and other ingredients, in accordance with food safety standards.
•	Monitoring ingredient quality, stock rotation and portion consistency to maintain food quality and minimise wastage.
•	Overseeing the preparation and coordination of kitchen operations during service to ensure meals are produced efficiently and consistently.



Qualifications:
•	Must hold Certificate III and Certificate IV in Commercial Cookery, along with a Diploma of Hospitality Management.
•	Should have at least one (1) year of Australian experience as a professional Chef.

Note: Australian citizens and permanent residents are preferred.
